# [Implementation] - [Phase 6] [Bug] Validate lint, posix-shell and tag on ubuntu-26.04 before flipping them off ubuntu-24.04

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #352 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Run every block from the worktree root. Each block is self-contained, writes only inside its own
`/tmp/opencode/smoke-352-*` sandbox, and removes that sandbox before it ends (no `trap … EXIT`, which
the next block's `trap` would overwrite in the concatenated script). The gate concatenates every
fenced body into one `set -e` script, so each block: (a) resolves `$REPO_ROOT` instead of trusting the
caller's cwd, (b) captures the status of the commands whose failure is an *assertion* and prints a
single `FAIL: …` line, and (c) ends with `[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]`. A setup command that cannot run at all
aborts under `set -e` *after* the check's marker was printed, so the gate still attributes it to the
right check.

These three checks are the part of #352 that is provable **without** GitHub, and they are
deliberately the highest-value parts: the pin map (what actually ships), the tag force-push script
(the one that moves production tags silently), and the POSIX launcher contract (the substance of the
`posix-shell` job). The authoritative 26.04 evidence for the container suite is the CI run in
Step 7 — no local engine can stand in for it, and this worktree's engine is a rootless/user-namespace
shim (`podman 4.9.3` behind `docker`), so a local ownership probe would produce a false negative.

**S1 — the migration is exactly three pins, and nothing else in the release graph moved**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
STATUS=0
WF="$REPO_ROOT/.github/workflows/ci.yml" CRIT="$REPO_ROOT/.github/workflows/critique.yml" WF_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/.github/workflows" node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
const ci = fs.readFileSync(process.env.WF, "utf8");
const critique = fs.readFileSync(process.env.CRIT, "utf8");
function jobs(source) {
  const lines = source.split("\n");
  const start = lines.findIndex((line) => /^jobs:\s*$/.test(line));
  if (start === -1) fail("no top-level jobs: block");
  const blocks = {};
  let current = null;
  let body = [];
  const flush = () => { if (current !== null) blocks[current] = body.join("\n"); body = []; };
  for (const line of lines.slice(start + 1)) {
    const job = line.match(/^ {2}([A-Za-z0-9_-]+):\s*$/);
    if (job) { flush(); current = job[1]; continue; }
    if (current !== null) body.push(line);
  }
  flush();
  return blocks;
}
function runner(body) {
  const match = body.match(/^ {4}runs-on:\s*(\S+)\s*$/m);
  if (!match) fail("a job has no runs-on");
  return match[1];
}
const ciJobs = jobs(ci);
const expected = { lint: "ubuntu-26.04", typecheck: "ubuntu-latest", test: "ubuntu-latest", "posix-shell": "ubuntu-26.04", tag: "ubuntu-26.04" };
const names = Object.keys(expected).sort();
if (Object.keys(ciJobs).sort().join(",") !== names.join(",")) fail("job set changed: " + Object.keys(ciJobs).join(","));
for (const name of names) {
  if (runner(ciJobs[name]) !== expected[name]) fail(name + " runs on " + runner(ciJobs[name]) + ", expected " + expected[name]);
}
if (runner(jobs(critique).review) !== "ubuntu-latest") fail("the critique canary left ubuntu-latest");
const all = ci + "\n" + critique;
if (all.includes("ubuntu-24.04")) fail("a workflow still names ubuntu-24.04");
if (/^\s+tags:/m.test(all)) fail("a workflow declares a tags: trigger");
if ((all.match(/git push -f\b/g) || []).length !== 1) fail("expected exactly one force-push site");
if (!ciJobs.tag.includes("git push -f")) fail("the force-push left the tag job");
if (!/github\.ref == .refs\/heads\/main./.test(ciJobs.tag)) fail("the tag job is no longer main-only");
if (!/needs: \[lint, typecheck, test\]/.test(ciJobs.tag)) fail("tag.needs changed");
if (!/continue-on-error: true/.test(ciJobs["posix-shell"])) fail("posix-shell is no longer a soak job");
for (const name of ["lint", "posix-shell", "tag"]) {
  if (!ciJobs[name].includes("#352")) fail(name + " does not cite the #352 validation");
}
for (const name of ["lint", "posix-shell"]) {
  if (!ciJobs[name].includes("docker version --format")) fail(name + " does not record the Docker engine version");
  if (!ciJobs[name].includes("uname -r")) fail(name + " does not record the kernel");
}
const files = fs.readdirSync(process.env.WF_DIR).filter((f) => /\.ya?ml$/.test(f)).sort();
if (files.join(",") !== "ci.yml,critique.yml") fail("unexpected workflow files: " + files.join(","));
console.log("OK S1: exactly three pins on ubuntu-26.04, canaries/release graph unchanged, engine recording present");
' || STATUS=$?
[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S2 — the shipped `Update Floating Tags` step force-moves only a throwaway namespace**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
mkdir -p /tmp/opencode
SMOKE=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opencode/smoke-352-tag-XXXXXX)
ORIGIN="$SMOKE/origin.git"
CLONE="$SMOKE/clone"
STEP="$SMOKE/update-floating-tags.sh"
LIVE_BEFORE=$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/tags)
STATUS=0
EXTRACT_STATUS=0
WF="$REPO_ROOT/.github/workflows/ci.yml" OUT="$STEP" node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const lines = fs.readFileSync(process.env.WF, "utf8").split("\n");
const start = lines.findIndex((line) => /^\s+- name: Update Floating Tags\s*$/.test(line));
if (start === -1) { console.error("FAIL: no Update Floating Tags step in ci.yml"); process.exit(1); }
let index = start;
while (index < lines.length && !/^\s+run:\s*\|/.test(lines[index])) index += 1;
if (index >= lines.length) { console.error("FAIL: the step has no run: | block"); process.exit(1); }
const indent = lines[index].match(/^\s*/)[0].length + 2;
const body = [];
for (index += 1; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
  const line = lines[index];
  if (line.trim().length === 0) { body.push(""); continue; }
  if (line.match(/^\s*/)[0].length < indent) break;
  body.push(line.slice(indent));
}
const script = body.join("\n").split("${{ steps.auto-tag.outputs.new-tag }}").join("9.9.9");
if (!script.includes("git push -f")) { console.error("FAIL: the extracted step no longer force-pushes"); process.exit(1); }
if (/https?:\/\/|git@/.test(script)) { console.error("FAIL: the extracted step hardcodes a remote URL"); process.exit(1); }
const pushes = script.split("\n").filter((line) => line.trim().startsWith("git push"));
if (pushes.length === 0) { console.error("FAIL: the extracted step has no git push"); process.exit(1); }
for (const line of pushes) {
  if (!/\borigin\b/.test(line)) { console.error("FAIL: a push does not target origin: " + line.trim()); process.exit(1); }
}
fs.writeFileSync(process.env.OUT, script + "\n");
console.log("extracted " + body.length + " lines from the shipped step");
' || EXTRACT_STATUS=$?
if [ "$EXTRACT_STATUS" -ne 0 ] || [ ! -s "$STEP" ]; then
  echo "FAIL: could not extract the Update Floating Tags step from ci.yml"
  STATUS=1
else
  git init -q --bare "$ORIGIN"
  git init -q "$CLONE"
  cd "$CLONE"
  git config user.email smoke@test
  git config user.name smoke
  printf 'seed\n' > README.md
  git add README.md
  git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
  git tag latest
  git remote add origin "$ORIGIN"
  git push -q origin HEAD:main latest
  printf '{"version":"9.9.9"}\n' > package.json
  git add package.json
  git commit -qm 'chore: 9.9.9'
  git tag 9.9.9
  git push -q origin HEAD:main 9.9.9
  BEFORE_LATEST=$(git rev-parse refs/tags/latest^{commit})
  bash "$STEP"
  VERIFY_STATUS=0
  ORIGIN="$ORIGIN" REPO_ROOT="$REPO_ROOT" LIVE_BEFORE="$LIVE_BEFORE" BEFORE_LATEST="$BEFORE_LATEST" node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const cp = require("child_process");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
const remote = (...args) => cp.execFileSync("git", ["-C", process.env.ORIGIN, ...args], { encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
const local = (...args) => cp.execFileSync("git", ["-C", process.env.REPO_ROOT, ...args], { encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
const newTag = remote("rev-parse", "refs/tags/9.9.9^{commit}");
for (const ref of ["refs/tags/9", "refs/tags/9.x", "refs/tags/latest"]) {
  if (remote("rev-parse", ref + "^{commit}") !== newTag) fail(ref + " does not point at 9.9.9");
}
if (remote("rev-parse", "refs/tags/latest^{commit}") === process.env.BEFORE_LATEST) fail("latest was not force-moved");
const tags = remote("for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/tags").split("\n").filter(Boolean).sort();
if (tags.join(",") !== "refs/tags/9,refs/tags/9.9.9,refs/tags/9.x,refs/tags/latest") fail("unexpected tag set: " + tags.join(","));
if (local("for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/tags") !== process.env.LIVE_BEFORE) fail("the worktree tag namespace changed");
if (!fs.existsSync(process.env.ORIGIN + "/refs/tags/latest")) fail("no floating latest ref was created");
console.log("OK S2: the shipped step created vX/vX.Y.x/latest, force-moved latest, and never left the throwaway remote");
' || VERIFY_STATUS=$?
  cd "$REPO_ROOT"
  [ "$VERIFY_STATUS" -eq 0 ] || STATUS=1
fi
rm -rf "$SMOKE"
[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S3 — the POSIX launcher contract the `posix-shell` job covers, on this kernel**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
mkdir -p /tmp/opencode
SMOKE=$(mktemp -d /tmp/opencode/smoke-352-shell-XXXXXX)
STATUS=0
echo "kernel: $(uname -r)"
echo "sh: $(readlink -f "$(command -v sh)")"
for s in codeloop agyloop setup-symlink.sh verify-install.sh; do
  if sh -n "bin/$s" 2> "$SMOKE/$s.err"; then
    echo "sh -n bin/$s OK"
  else
    echo "FAIL: bin/$s is not valid POSIX shell"
    cat "$SMOKE/$s.err"
    STATUS=1
  fi
done
./bin/codeloop --help > "$SMOKE/codeloop.out" 2> "$SMOKE/codeloop.err" || STATUS=1
if grep -q '^Usage:' "$SMOKE/codeloop.out"; then
  echo "codeloop --help OK"
else
  echo "FAIL: codeloop --help has no Usage: on stdout"
  cat "$SMOKE/codeloop.err"
  STATUS=1
fi
if grep -qi deprecated "$SMOKE/codeloop.err"; then
  echo "FAIL: codeloop --help printed a deprecation notice"
  STATUS=1
fi
./bin/agyloop --help > "$SMOKE/agyloop.out" 2> "$SMOKE/agyloop.err" || STATUS=1
if grep -q '^Usage:' "$SMOKE/agyloop.out"; then
  echo "agyloop --help OK"
else
  echo "FAIL: agyloop --help has no Usage: on stdout"
  STATUS=1
fi
if grep -qF "Warning: The 'agyloop' command is deprecated. Please use 'codeloop' instead." "$SMOKE/agyloop.err"; then
  echo "agyloop deprecation notice OK"
else
  echo "FAIL: agyloop --help is missing the exact deprecation notice"
  cat "$SMOKE/agyloop.err"
  STATUS=1
fi
rm -rf "$SMOKE"
[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```
